notes: Vaulty answers for itself now. Ask 'could you find me a good warframe to use' and you get real picks with reasons — the recommender reasons over the whole Vault (roles, stats, mastery, farm sources, build tags), spreads across roles when you don't name a goal, and asks one sharpening question back instead of punting. Ordering rule: research and composing run BEFORE the honest don't-know can appear — it is the last resort in every path. New: the optional Vaulty AI download comes to phones — capability-checked first (WebGPU, storage, memory), smallest phone-sized model, explicit tap only, cancel any time, one-tap off switch and delete; on iPhone it is labeled experimental and a failed load settles into quick mode forever, never a loop. Vaulty grows: your thumbs up/down on answers re-rank recommendations on your device, missed questions are kept in a 'What Vaulty is learning' view, and asking 'how do you learn?' gets the honest answer. Also new: Build Checker (paste your build — legality, wrong-class mods, unrecognized names and capacity vs real drain, with verified swaps), My Arsenal ('I have Saryn Prime' — recommendations prefer your gear and say what unowned picks take), Farm Watch ('I'm farming Lith A1' — a nudge when a matching fissure, alert or invasion is live), a once-a-day Daily Brief on chat open, follow-up chips after real answers, live answers stamped with the moment the feed answered — invasions included — and optional voice in/out (mic button where supported, spoken replies off by default).
